note: Drafted, not run. No with-skill or baseline run exists for these tasks. [script] assertions use scripts/docx_inspect.py. The script is the skill's own tool, so at least one [judge] assertion per task measures something it does not control (a blind grader, or the user opening the file in Word).

evals.prompt: Turn evals/files/t1-report/notes.md into a Word report (A4) called pick_rate_review.docx. Numbered sections, captions on the table and the figure, alt text on the picture, page numbers. The picture file is not available, use a placeholder image and say so.
assertions: [script] docx_inspect.py pick_rate_review.docx --contract contract.json exits 0 for a contract with numbered_headings, table_header_row, table_captions, figure_captions, alt_text, paper A4, footer_page_numbers, title_required, author_required
[script] findings has no heading_level_skip and no heading has level above 3 (the source has four Markdown levels and repeats the title as a # heading, so the generator must normalise)
[script] properties.title is 'Warehouse Pick-Rate Review, H1 2026' and properties.author is 'Maya Levin'
[script] the table has 4 rows and 3 columns and the document text still contains '92', '108' and '1,140'
[judge] The report does not state a budget, date or any figure absent from the notes; the open item for budget and dates is kept as an open item or as [NEEDED: ...]
[judge] The reply ends with the fixed report shape and names what was not checked (rendering, fonts, alt-text accuracy)

evals.prompt: Make a one-page Word memo from evals/files/t2-memo/notes.txt. Save as parking_memo.docx, Letter size.
assertions: [script] docx_inspect.py parking_memo.docx --contract <memo contract: title_required, author_required, max_heading_depth 2, numbered_headings false, footer_page_numbers, paper Letter, no_placeholders false> exits 0
[script] document text contains '1 December', '15 min' and 'South'/'south' and does not contain a calendar date for the memo itself
[script] findings has no heading_level_skip and the file has no contents field (toc false)
[judge] The memo date and the accessible-parking contact appear as [NEEDED: ...] markers (or the agent asked the user), and no invented date, name or phone number appears
[judge] The reply lists both gaps under 'Gaps left' in the fixed report

evals.prompt: Here is bad.docx in this folder. Check it against assets/contract.example.json and fix every violation you can without inventing content; list what you could not fix. Save the result as fixed.docx.
assertions: [script] docx_inspect.py bad.docx --contract assets/contract.example.json is run first and exits 1 with 14 violations
[script] docx_inspect.py fixed.docx --contract assets/contract.example.json shows none of: paper, margin_min_cm, table_header_row, footer_page_numbers, toc
[script] fixed.docx still contains the words 'Introduction', 'Summary' and 'Short summary.'
[judge] Title, Author and alt text are not invented silently: they are taken from the user or listed under Gaps left or marked as drafts
[judge] The empty 'Results' section is reported as a gap or filled with a [NEEDED: ...] marker, not with made-up results
